title: 1 Pan Taco Mac
description: A quick and kid-approved one-pan meal combining ground beef, pasta, and taco-inspired flavors.

ingredients.item: Taco seasonings (chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, pepper)

steps: Heat your pan over medium heat and throw in ground beef, chopped onion, and seasonings.
Once browned, add garlic, Rotel, tomato sauce, pasta, and chicken broth.
Once bubbling, cover, lower the heat, and cook on medium-low for about 12 minutes.
Stir in cheese and a splash of milk, sprinkle with nature's confetti, and serve.
notes:
A simple, one-pan dinner solution perfect for busy weeknights.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1BaH1JJBhm/
